title: CSS Pseudo-elements for Text
text:
CSS Pseudo-elements for Text Pseudo-elements for Text Pseudo-elements for text, allow you to style specific parts of text content, such as the first line or first letter. The CSS ::first-line Pseudo-element The ::first-line pseudo-element is used to add a special style to the first line of a text. Note: The ::first-line pseudo-element can only be applied to block-level elements. The CSS ::first-letter Pseudo-element The ::first-letter pseudo-element is used to add a special style to the first letter of a text. Note: The ::first-letter pseudo-element can only be applied to block-level elements. Pseudo-elements and HTML Classes Pseudo-elements can easily be combined with HTML classes.
